rationale: Both reviews are deeply code-grounded (file:line citations, verified against pipeline_minimax_h3.py etc.) and independently converge on the same core defects: the orphaned supported_models.md footnote and the factually-wrong reference-count bullet. X additionally catches the docs-build-failure root cause (mkdocs --strict / recipes/ outside the docs tree) that two ground-truth reviewers explicitly flagged as CHANGES_REQUESTED, and the MI325X/MI355X naming-precision nit tied to Xunzhuo's ask — both entirely absent from Y. Y misses the docs-build item and the separate-file preference altogether, giving it noticeably lower recall despite comparable precision and actionability (both use concrete file/line refs and concrete fixes, though X's Blocking/Should-fix/Nits structure with inline suggested rewrites is marginally more actionable than Y's audit-log style output).
